.²1 To cause to be or become, call into existence, call into being; {#te#}
 {#vE brahmaRa AdeSAt kaTametadaBAvayan#} <ls>Bhāg. 3. 20. 10</ls>.
.²2 To cause, produce, effect.
.²3 To manifest, display, exhibit.

.²8 To purify.
.²9 To get, obtain.
.²10 To mingle or mix.
.²11 To change or transform into.
.²12 To soak, steep.
.²13 To devote or addict oneself to.
.²14 To convince.
.²15 To perfume, scent.
